title: Board / Disembark
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_trait | common | Move
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | GM Core 236
property | Cost | 1 action
property | Requires | Adjacent to a vehicle entry point, or already aboard
text | Enter through an open top, door, portal, or hatch. If already aboard, disembark into an empty space adjacent to an entry point.
text | If the vehicle is moving, you need a successful Acrobatics or Athletics check against its AC.
text | Boarding does not give you control. Move to the controls and use Take Control to become the pilot.

title: Take Control
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_trait | common | Manipulate
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 205; GM Core 236
property | Cost | 1 action, usually
property | Requires | Trained Piloting; aboard and adjacent to controls
text | Attempt a Piloting check against the vehicle’s piloting DC, adjusted for circumstances.
text | Success: Become its pilot, or regain control if it was uncontrolled. Failure does not give you control.
text | Complicated controls can make this a multi-action activity.
text | You need usable access to the controls. This action does not automatically bypass locks, security, or someone physically preventing access.

title: Drive
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_trait | common | Move
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 204; GM Core 236
property | Cost | 1–3 actions
property | Requires | Trained Piloting; you are the pilot
text | Choose the action cost before moving. You cannot Drive through creatures’ spaces, including allies.
text | 1 action: Piloting check. Success: move up to Speed and turn normally. Failure: move full Speed straight ahead. Critical failure: as failure, and become uncontrolled.
text | 2 actions — reckless: On a successful control check, move up to twice Speed straight ahead.
text | 3 actions — reckless: Take −5 on the control check. On success, move up to three times Speed straight ahead.
text | For failed reckless checks, use the Reckless Piloting card. A vehicle gets only one move action/activity per round.

title: Stop
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_trait | common | Manipulate
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 205; GM Core 236
property | Cost | 1 action
property | Requires | Trained Piloting; piloting a moving vehicle
text | Bring the vehicle to a stop. This action lists no check.
text | If the vehicle moved last round, you must use a vehicle move action or Stop this turn. Doing neither causes it to become uncontrolled.
text | If already uncontrolled, first regain control with Take Control.

title: Run Over
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_trait | common | Move
p2e_trait | common | Reckless
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 205; GM Core 236
property | Cost | 3 actions
property | Requires | Trained Piloting; you are the pilot
text | First make a reckless control check. On success, move up to twice Speed straight ahead.
text | Run over creatures at least two sizes smaller than the vehicle. You may ram one creature or object one size smaller than the vehicle or larger.
text | Targets take the vehicle’s collision damage with a basic Reflex save at its collision DC. A rammed vehicle’s pilot can substitute a piloting check.
text | If a rammed target takes damage, you and your vehicle each take collision damage with no save, and movement ends.
text | For a Huge truck: Medium or smaller creatures can be run over; Large or larger targets can be rammed.

title: Stunt
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_trait | common | Manipulate
p2e_trait | common | Move
p2e_trait | common | Reckless
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 205
property | Cost | 1 action
property | Requires | Trained Piloting; driving a vehicle
text | Drive as part of this action and choose a stunt from the Stunt Options card. Apply its penalty to all Piloting checks attempted as part of the Stunt, including reckless checks.
text | Stunt is reckless: first check to keep control. If the Drive and the Stunt are both reckless, make two control checks.
text | Use the listed movement change or benefit. The GM determines which stunts are physically possible for the vehicle and terrain.
text | The printed stunt table does not specify a duration for Evade/Barrel Roll’s AC bonus. Agree on a duration with the GM before using either; this card does not add a house-rule duration.

title: Stunt Options
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 205
property | Cost | Reference for Stunt
property | Requires | Apply the penalty to all Piloting checks during Stunt
text | Back Off (−1): Move half Speed backward.
text | Evade (−1): Move half Speed; gain +1 status bonus to AC.
text | Flip and Burn (−1): Move half Speed, then turn any direction.
text | Barrel Roll (−2): Move half Speed; gain +2 status bonus to AC.
text | Flyby (−2): Move half Speed through an enemy square.
text | Drift (−2): Move half Speed sideways without turning.
text | Turn in Place (−2): Turn, then move full Speed.
text | Vehicle capability and terrain determine which stunts make sense. See Stunt for checks and the AC-duration note.

title: Navigate
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_trait | common | Exploration
p2e_trait | common | Secret
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 204
property | Cost | Exploration; usually ~1 minute
property | Requires | Trained Piloting
text | Plan a short journey, including a route on foot, by vehicle, or within a star system. Normally make a secret Piloting check once per day; conditions may require more.
text | The GM sets DC and time; unfamiliar or unusual environments can require higher training.
text | Critical success: Excellent orientation; know cardinal directions exactly where they exist.
text | Success: Enough orientation to avoid becoming hopelessly lost; a general sense of cardinal directions.
text | This does not automatically locate an unknown settlement or missing person. Express Driver is a separate feat for long-term vehicle travel.

title: Reckless / Uncontrolled
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | Player Core 206; GM Core 236–237
property | Cost | Vehicle rules reference
property | Requires | Read alongside Drive, Stunt, and Run Over
text | Reckless: Before the action, check Piloting to retain control, applying listed penalties. Success resolves the action normally.
text | Failure: Move the vehicle’s Speed straight along its previous heading (GM may drift it up to 45°); it becomes uncontrolled.
text | Uncontrolled: On the previous pilot’s initiative each round, move straight ahead, 10 feet less than the previous round, until stopped or crashed. Terrain can alter this.
text | Resolve obstacles and creatures using Run Over, with that uncontrolled movement distance. Use Take Control to regain control.

title: Vehicle Basics
contents: p2e_start_trait_section
p2e_end_trait_section
property | Source | GM Core 235–237
property | Cost | Vehicle rules reference
property | Requires | Vehicle’s statblock
text | The pilot spends their own actions. A vehicle participates in only one move action/activity each round, even if pilots change.
text | Momentum: If it moved last round, use a vehicle move action or Stop, or it becomes uncontrolled.
text | Heading: Normally move forward; turn up to 90° for each vehicle length traveled. Use an appropriate Stunt to alter this.
text | Moving attacks: Attacks from a vehicle that moved in the last round take −2; use −4 if uncontrolled or any action in that round was reckless.
text | Piloting DCs rise for adverse conditions. Cover depends on the vehicle and angle of attack.
